bugs.error_message: Pressing Enter to save the leaderboard name also started a dive behind the leaderboard screen
bugs.root_cause: GameScene's keydown-ENTER/SPACE handlers start a run whenever state is 'title'; the leaderboard is an HTML screen over the title, so the state was still 'title' while typing
bugs.fix: keyStart() in GameScene ignores Space/Enter when ui.typing() (an input has focus) or ui.isOpen('board'); the name field also disables Phaser keyboard capture on focus so Space can be typed

bugs.error_message: Frozen Trench: falling icicles almost always hit the diver when passing under them
bugs.root_cause: Icicles triggered at a fixed 170-320px ahead; shake+fall (~0.8s) at 200-400px/s forward speed landed them right on the diver, and a falling icicle sweeps the full trench height so steering can't dodge
bugs.fix: Trigger is time-based (reach time < shake + fall time + per-icicle lead 0.25-0.5s) so it lands before you arrive; landed icicles stick in the floor as a stub to swim over; spawn far enough ahead for top/turbo speed

bugs.error_message: Frozen Trench: icicles always land before the diver reaches them, so they never hit
bugs.root_cause: The previous fix (deep-dive-icicles-unavoidable) timed every icicle to land 0.25-0.5s before you arrive, and the floor stub was half buried (15-26px tall), so there was nothing to dodge
bugs.fix: 45% of icicles are 'late': timed by your speed and width to still be falling as you pass and land 0.12-0.25s after you're clear, so swimming low slips under them and staying high gets hit. Stubs bury less (ICICLE_SINK 0.3)

bugs.error_message: Power-ups (Turbo, shield, magnet) sometimes don't show up; the spawn log shows type undefined and the sprite uses Phaser's __DEFAULT (blank) texture
bugs.root_cause: The power-up pick reused one random number for the lifeline roll and the pick among the rest: ((r - lc) / (1 - lc)) * rest.length goes negative when r < lc but the lifeline isn't allowed (you already hold one, or depth <= 120 m), so rest[-1] is undefined. About a quarter of power-ups vanished while holding a lifeline
bugs.fix: Roll the lifeline only when it's allowed, otherwise cpick(rest) evenly

bugs.error_message: A bordered box shows on the title screen before the diver loads
bugs.root_cause: #showcaseImg (and shell/chest icons) are tags with no src until BootScene draws the portraits; with a CSS width the browser draws its broken-image box
bugs.fix: img:not([src]), img[src=''] { visibility: hidden } in style.css

bugs.error_message: Best depth dropped (player saw 3620, then 3250); the leaderboard only had 3261, so 3620 never reached it
bugs.root_cause: cloud.ts merge() is last-writer-wins for the whole save: on start it pulls the cloud save before pushing local changes, and apply() overwrites every key. A best set before the sync connected (offline, or right after opening) was replaced by an older cloud save with a lower best, and was never submitted to the board
bugs.fix: apply() keeps the higher value for keys matching /^best/ and reports it; merge() then stamps the save as new and pushes it back up. Can't recover a best already overwritten on every device

bugs.error_message: Leaderboard best only counts the first cave (Reef Trench); deeper dives in other caves never posted
bugs.root_cause: endDive posted scores only when def.id === 'reef'; cloud startup/rename and the board's own row read store 'best' (reef key) only
bugs.fix: topBest() in cloud.ts takes the max of best and best:<cave>; endDive posts from every cave (not daily, not dev) when depth beats topBest; board, startup resubmit and rename use topBest

bugs.error_message: Installed iPhone PWA shows a coloured band at the bottom under the game (all games)
bugs.root_cause: iOS 26 standalone + viewport-fit=cover + black-translucent status bar: viewport is shorter than the screen by the status bar height (WebKit 301108), so position:fixed inset:0 layers stop short and body background shows
bugs.fix: In @media (display-mode: standalone|fullscreen) size html/body/#game/#ui (and Ripple #safe, store .player) to min(100lvh, 100dvh + env(safe-area-inset-top)); Deep Dive portrait uses it as the rotated #game width

bugs.error_message: First-dive easing (5 lives, slower pace, gentler air) switched off seconds into the run
bugs.root_cause: Easing keyed off `learned`, which flips true as soon as the steering guide completes
bugs.fix: Added `rookie` flag set once at dive start; all easing reads it

bugs.error_message: HUD drew 3 life icons when a first dive had 5 lives
bugs.root_cause: #hearts markup has 3 static SVGs; setHearts only toggled them
bugs.fix: setHearts(n, max) clones/removes icons to match max at dive start and on Save Me
